text: Silverthorn Avenue extends from St. Clair Avenue West and Rogers Road and is often used as a thoroughfare to bypass heavy traffic on surrounding arterial roads. With increased development and growth in the area and increased vehicular traffic, pedestrian safety has become a community concern. In addition, we have all experienced traffic complications from the underpass on St. Clair Avenue West, between Old Weston Road and Keele Street, as this junction has become a serious bottleneck that has crippled traffic on St. Clair Avenue West and negatively affected our local roads. Given the proximity to General Mercer Junior Public School and S.A.D.R.A. Park, it is necessary to poll the community as they have witnessed excessive speeding and a blatant disregard for the posted traffic regulations. To avoid unnecessary delay, it is important that authority be given now for a poll to be carried…

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and approved the installation of traffic calming on Silverthorn Avenue, between Pryor Avenue and Rowntree Avenue. 2. Requested the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway on Silverthorn Avenue, between Pryor Avenue and Rowntree Avenue for traffic calming purposes, generally as shown on Drawings EY18-072A and EY18-072B, dated June 2018. 3. Directed Transportation Services take to the necessary actions to reduce the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Silverthorn Avenue, between St. Clair Avenue West and a point 38.1 metres north of Rowntree Avenue and also reduce the speed limit from 50km/h to 30km/h on Silverthorn Avenue, between a point 38.1 metres north of Rowntree Avenue and Rogers Road, when the speed humps are installed.
